I will keep it simple and do what fits Quzhou County best: I will plant a wheat-maize rotation on all my land. Here, that is the safest way for me to earn steadily because the climate, irrigation habits, and local experience all match winter wheat followed by summer maize. I do not want to spread myself across too many crops, because with my education level and the need to manage work carefully, I would rather do two crops I know well than chase a riskier return. I will use improved or hybrid seed, put on enough fertilizer to protect yield, irrigate several times for wheat and fewer times for maize, and use normal pest control instead of over-spraying. For tillage, I will use rotary tillage because it is practical and common for me. I will aim for stable output, not the highest possible output, because stable harvest matters more to me than taking extra risk.
